history.content: What did the dynamic assessment studies find?

Three studies used dynamic assessment. A group dynamic assessment (G-DA) study with Thai undergraduates improved academic writing across organization, content, vocabulary, language use and mechanics. A computerized dynamic reading assessment (CDRA) program improved the reading comprehension of lower-proficiency undergraduates. A third study combined dynamic assessment with vocabulary learning strategies and improved academic vocabulary knowledge of low-proficiency undergraduates.
